source.buildspec:
version: 0.2

env:
  shell: bash

phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      python: 3.12
    commands:
      - echo "Installing the assignment grading toolchain"
      - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
      - python3 -m pip install pytest pytest-json-report

  pre_build:
    commands:
      - |
        git config --global credential.helper '!f() { echo username=x-access-token; echo password=$GITHUB_TOKEN; }; f'
      - echo "Grading source revision $CODEBUILD_RESOLVED_SOURCE_VERSION"
      - |
        if [ -n "$STUDENT_REPO_URL" ]; then
          echo "Cloning the private student submission repository"
          git clone --depth 1 "$STUDENT_REPO_URL" "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/student_code"
        else
          echo "No student repository supplied - grading the checked out assignment source"
        fi

  build:
    commands:
      - echo "Executing the grader against the student code"
      - |
        set +e
        if [ -d "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/student_code" ]; then
          (cd "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/student_code" && python3 -m pytest --json-report --json-report-file="$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/results.json")
        else
          python3 -m pytest --json-report --json-report-file="$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/results.json"
        fi
        GRADER_EXIT_CODE=$?
        set -e
        if [ "$GRADER_EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 ]; then
          GRADE_STATUS="PASSED"
        else
          GRADE_STATUS="FAILED"
        fi
        echo "$GRADE_STATUS" > "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/grade_status.txt"
        echo "$GRADER_EXIT_CODE" > "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/grader_exit_code.txt"
        echo "Grader finished with status $GRADE_STATUS"

  post_build:
    commands:
      - GRADE_STATUS=$(cat "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/grade_status.txt")
      - GRADER_EXIT_CODE=$(cat "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/grader_exit_code.txt")
      - |
        if [ ! -f "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/results.json" ]; then
          printf '{"submission_id": "%s", "status": "%s", "grader_exit_code": "%s"}' "$CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID" "$GRADE_STATUS" "$GRADER_EXIT_CODE" > "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/results.json"
        fi
      - |
        printf '{"submission_id": {"S": "%s"}, "status": {"S": "%s"}, "build_id": {"S": "%s"}, "graded_at": {"S": "%s"}}' "$CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID" "$GRADE_STATUS" "$CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/grade_record.json"
      - aws s3 cp "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/results.json" "s3://$RESULTS_BUCKET/results/$CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID/results.json"
      - aws s3 cp "$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/grade_record.json" "s3://$RESULTS_BUCKET/results/$CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID/grade_record.json"
      - aws dynamodb put-item --table-name "$GRADES_TABLE" --item "file://$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/grade_record.json"
      - echo "Grading results uploaded for submission $CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID"

artifacts:
  files:
    - results.json
    - grade_record.json
